_about: Mutation-test targets for this plugin. Each target names the file to mutate and
the test command that must notice a change (the fast module that covers it).
Run with tools/mutator.py, or as part of tools/run_tests.sh.
min_kill_rate is the floor: below it the run fails, and a target that yields no
mutants at all fails too, so a mutation pass can never be green over nothing.
per_operator caps how many occurrences of each operator are mutated (determinism
and runtime); raise it for a deeper nightly run via --max-rate/--only.

targets.note: its own tests drive the runner, so a mutant in the capping/slicing logic can make a nested run hang; 25 mutants and a 30s ceiling keep the target practical while still covering the runner end to end
DOM-heavy; only the extractable logic is covered so far. Targeted so the gap is measured rather than hidden, per the no-gaps rule.

two mutants on this line: the enclosing try/catch swallows the out-of-range access, and b < 4000 would need a 4000-block article
